blockers.reason: The connected GitHub interface does not expose independently reproducible branch-protection rule-set evidence sufficient to prove that the future dedicated bot identity cannot bypass main protection.
blockers.smallest_lawful_resolution: Provide a reproducible branch-protection or ruleset export bound to the repository and dedicated bot identity, showing direct main writes and bypass are denied.

blockers.reason: No dedicated revocable receipt-bot identity with the approved minimal permissions is provisioned. The operator GitHub connector is not that identity and cannot lawfully substitute.
blockers.smallest_lawful_resolution: Provision the dedicated revocable identity, record only its non-secret identity hash and permission evidence, then run one allowlisted proposal-branch shadow without merge authority.

prohibited_resolution: Do not use the operator connector as the bot shadow identity.
Do not mark branch protection PASS from assumptions or repository permissions alone.
Do not activate the profile, provision broad credentials or weaken tests.
Do not merge, force-push, rewrite history or delete accepted evidence.
rollback: Keep the profile inactive and provision no credential until both blockers are reproducibly resolved.
